updates.note: Management reiterated the target of 50 hotel openings this year, with 30 expected in the second half.
updates.quote: We are also on track to achieve our target of 50 hotel openings this year. That means 30 hotels are expected to open in the second half of this year.

updates.note: Management reiterated expectations of sustaining high teens management fee growth.
updates.quote: Looking ahead, we remain confident of sustaining management fee growth at a high teens CAGR

updates.note: Guidance raised from 12%-14% to 15%-17% consolidated revenue growth for FY27.
updates.quote: Accordingly, we are revising our full year growth guidance upwards to 15% to 17%.

updates.note: Management noted portfolio has crossed 670 hotels.
updates.quote: taking our portfolio to 670 hotels with over 69,000 keys in operation or under development.

new_promises.statement: Ginger brand is on track to reach 150 operational hotels by March 31, FY27.
new_promises.quote: Ginger became India's first hotel brand. Yes, it became India's first hotel brand to reach 100 operational hotels and is on track to reach 150 by March 31, FY27.
new_promises.speaker: Puneet Chhatwal

new_promises.statement: IHCL expects Hotel segment revenue to grow by 17% to 19% in FY27.
new_promises.quote: And within that, the Hotel segment revenue is expected to grow by 17% to 19%.
new_promises.speaker: Puneet Chhatwal
